notes.title: Vampire Clans Demo is live now!
notes.content:
Greetings, Vampires!

We're thrilled to announce that the Vampire Clans Demo is live now! Prepare for a dark hunt and join the fight for power and influence, crushing your enemies with your supernatural powers. Create your own Vampire Lord and develop abilities, get equipment, and rebuild your Clan.

[previewyoutube=_UyA2OZM3aE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Empower your Vampires[/h3]
Crush your enemies with your inhuman strength, agility, and Blood Powers. Develop attributes, acquire equipment, and learn fighting techniques that change the rules of combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/e0ef1585beb2f0974acf0f3d0e8745c4724eb9bf.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/789462352a825d16463fb0a12bc32f8c42112de0.gif[/img]


[h3]Expand your Castle[/h3]
Send your Ghouls to work rebuilding your Castle, and research technologies to unlock additional rooms that strengthen your Clan and Vampires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/03c25e22ac4ce66c6a5743d486b9565ce9b41e26.gif[/img]


[h3]Drink your enemies' blood[/h3]
Strike fear into mortals by crushing their protectors and drinking the blood of their fellows. Become a terrifying predator feared by all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/9dc86329f6c24e03003ceea2259acbd723a28bcd.gif[/img]


[h3]Explore the World[/h3]
Explore an open world full of possibilities. Hunt humans, animals, and foul creatures. Forge connections with other clans or fight with them. Rule the world where the most significant threat is you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/e08a28a0dc0e951a8c04a0a841b26c3255be721d.gif[/img]



[h3]Share Your Feedback![/h3]
Join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/pTYRKXEBjM]Discord Channel[/url] and build a community that influences Vampire Clans' development. Discuss with players and developers about the game's mechanics, strategies, and all things related to the game. 

[url=https://discord.gg/pTYRKXEBjM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/bd47cb0be0671c138e5103292f8880b107a5e40a.png[/img][/url]


Thank you for being part of our community and helping us make Vampire Clans the best it can be. We’re looking forward to your feedback, and we can’t wait to see the stories you create within the game.

Happy hunting,
The Vampire Clans Team

notes.title: Devlog #17
notes.content:
Hello Vampires!

There are very few mechanics left to finish. We are currently working on an introductory level to the story that includes tutorial elements, and we are finishing work on blood management, which will be introduced in the next devlog.

[h3]Equipping items[/h3]
We've expanded character stats and the ways to influence them. While we could previously assign stat points, we've now added the ability to equip items that affect stats. Characters can currently equip armor, boots, a headpiece, an amulet, and two rings, with each item affecting different stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/dd4ca7e9acd0de7e636a7d5412c0473691b0bde8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/949fe212cabe9e6645ff606ac50d8135102c654f.png[/img]

[h3]Dungeons and catacombs[/h3]
We've introduced the ability to explore dungeons and catacombs, where you can loot unique items protected by beasts that dwell in the darkness. The challenges waiting underground will be much more demanding than those above ground, but the rewards will be worth it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/82b58672e93680e2dc3d298a29cf07023669cf3b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/a812a8d3c231cbda5974e13edeb47dba4ac88c5f.png[/img]

[h3]More and more enemies[/h3]
The game world is seeing an increasing variety of enemy types, with more animals, humans, and creatures like ghouls added. Each enemy has its own evolution stages, depending on the difficulty of the area in which it appears.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/cf45d8f1f054a8acd56d26d12171ae611fb162da.gif[/img]

[h3]Prologue of the story[/h3]
We're finalizing a level introducing the player to the game's story and mechanics. This will be the only scripted level designed to teach the game's mechanics. After completing this introduction, you will be free to explore the world, uncovering its secrets. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/865b84e2edd609d6262f3e003049a1db28ff3828.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/9cdcefb7f6d4f7c7d86c8d189d20b8d6bc9f50a8.png[/img]


If you have any questions or ideas, please let us know in the comments or on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/pTYRKXEBjM"]Discord[/url] Channel.
[url="https://discord.com/invite/pTYRKXEBjM"]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/bd47cb0be0671c138e5103292f8880b107a5e40a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #16
notes.content:
Hello Vampires!

Most of the mechanics are behind us; we are currently polishing and adding content to the world. This month, we focus on implementing two character classes, including their skills. We are also working on the final UI, some of which can already be seen in the GIFs. 

[h3]Animals and creatures[/h3]
Vampires won’t be fighting just humanoid characters anymore. We’ve added animals and other creatures to engage the player’s vampires when alerted. Most of these beings will try to scare the vampires off, but if approached too closely, they’ll strike. Defeated animals drop special alchemical ingredients essential for crafting potions that make gameplay easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/bf249476bef328a76a9f5970fed6e11e311422d9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/68f214c70875dccba48abc818c657fa102847e15.gif[/img]

[h3]Combat movement[/h3]
We’ve improved hitbox detection, making combat more intuitive. Vampires can avoid enemy attacks through precise movement alone, without relying on the dodge mechanic. This makes combat even more engaging. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/b9fe8d0e356b92db4bad7678f1e6c8e4ff1c82fb.gif[/img]

[h3]Quests [/h3]
We have placed many story quests in the game world, allowing you to gain experience and valuable items. Quests also make it easier to explore the game world, but they are still optional, and almost any story character can be killed by the player's vampires. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/3bc020d13ad6ed6121c31ee1805eea3145a4901a.gif[/img]

[h3]Land takeover[/h3]
The player's clan can now take over areas belonging to enemy clans, which provides a steady inflow of resources. Taking over the enemy area is preceded by an optional series of quests to create a resistance movement to facilitate the clash with the enemy clan. The takeover ends with a fight with the area's overseer, a high-ranked vampire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/c1e1e87c3a7b4c9dc1d0929b932877dc869fe023.gif[/img]

[h3]Travel and checkpoints[/h3]
Vampires can now travel using crypts, which are secret entrances to the catacombs. Once unlocked, the passage allows for fast travel between areas of the world and the castle. In addition, they also serve as checkpoints. Additional checkpoints are coffins, which allow vampires to be resurrected in the event of their defeat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/199795e823000dc5787d925bab802e863549169b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/fc3c055d6b61cae94741336f85b724e7b7c1e23f.png[/img]


If you have any questions or ideas, please let us know in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pTYRKXEBjM]Discord[/url] Channel.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/pTYRKXEBjM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/bd47cb0be0671c138e5103292f8880b107a5e40a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #15
notes.content:
Hello Vampires! 

In the last devlog, we announced planned changes in the game mechanics based on your surveys. Since then, we have managed to implement most of them. 

[h3]World[/h3]
The world is open; the player is limited only by the enemies in a given area, but they are not artificially strengthened when the player's level is too low. The enemies' power increases with the player's actions. When the player kills people in an area, the area is fortified, bringing in more substantial defenders. After a few such strengthenings, vampire hunters appear in the area, who roam the area in search of vampires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/3cd41de9ea04aa9b9b78909678bd778ea9d77a02.png[/img]

[h3]Movement[/h3]
The controls are now WASD-based, and the player can freely rotate the camera and zoom in and out. The controls in Chronostasis remain unchanged. We are still working on improving the animations.
We added a dash ability, which allows us to dodge incoming attacks; when the player dodges the attack at the perfect moment, a speed buff is applied. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/e2d7f765bf106b7d81bc3cf6c2a2c778b2ac1e7b.gif[/img]

[h3]Combat[/h3]
We've made some huge changes to the combat system. Chronostasis is now a powerful secondary mode, but fighting without it will still be possible and satisfying.
We've changed the basic attack. Now, attacking doesn't block the character; instead, the movement of the controlled vampire slows down, but it can still be controlled while attacking. Some other skills can also be used while the character is moving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/7de584ad7bcb043533032b7b55e6c18ea679d192.gif[/img]
Aiming some skills, mainly projectiles (e.g., Blood Ball), ends when the skill starts flying toward the enemy (previously, the possibility of aiming ended when the casting started).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/80135a255956260a3c3fa82c73dc774b934c41c3.gif[/img]
We implemented more complex statistics to balance the fights better. There are different damage types, defenses, and resistances. Enemies are more vulnerable to some damage types than others; for example, heavily armored vampire hunters will block much physical damage but will be susceptible to mind control. The player can now prepare the vampires' team for different journeys based on the enemies in the given area. 

Also, there is more damage feedback, including new sounds, physics, blood, VFX, and animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/7f484ac63e844a043bf8a8617eb0a7b03f57c4ac.gif[/img]

[h3]Stealth[/h3]
Aggressive enemies have dynamic detection cones. When the vampire is in the detection range, the cone fills. If the fill field reaches the vampire, detection is finished, and the enemies start fighting. The detection speed depends on the enemy's statistics (better-trained enemies such as Gendarmes detect faster), the vampire's current behavior (destroying things and using skills attracts more attention), and the crimes that vampires have committed before in the given area.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/043c51344da7636a14416631c9d787268481105b.gif[/img]

[h3]Story[/h3]
We deleted unnecessary story parts from the game to allow the player to make his own story. There will be no more walking with NPCs or too-long dialogues. We deleted the mechanics' limitations based on the story's progress. There will be hints in the Castle instead of the quests, and quests in the World won't be mandatory. You will be able to choose which quest you are willing to accomplish. 
The dialogues are no longer linear. The player can now choose the answers and thus influence the game world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/f01adb0241a01966f4c9e0be042a51597d1a9aca.gif[/img]




If you have any questions or ideas, please let us know in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.gg/pTYRKXEBjM]Discord Channel[/url].
[url=https://discord.gg/pTYRKXEBjM]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/4119f770ac6f9a1e167a96b9caa9e236bd09b7f5.png[/img]
[/url]

notes.title: The Playtest is over - conclusions
notes.content:
Hello Vampires! Thank you for taking part in the Vampire Clans Playtest. 

The numerous surveys we received allowed us to make decisions regarding the game's further development. 


[h3] World [/h3]
In Playtest, the world was very limited; it came down to a tutorial that told the player what to do. Now, we are preparing an open world where each vampire lord can do whatever they want. The player will be able to explore the world on their own or with the help of quests from other vampires and influential characters.

The world will react to the player's actions; each location will have awareness system that enhances vampire threat level. Suppose the player is constantly killing people in an area. In that case, it will be reinforced with additional patrols of Gendarmes and Vampire Hunters, civilians will hide in their houses, and the atmosphere will become darker and darker, new encouters will be bloodier and more difficult.


[h3] Movement [/h3]
Many of you wanted to enable camera rotation and let the player zoom in, so we did that. We will also enable keyboard controls, limiting the need for point-and-click to Chronostasis mode.
We also plan to develop movement animations to make them more smooth.


[h3] Combat [/h3]
The feedback on combat was mixed, with many surveys indicating that Chronostasis mode was difficult to use but overpowered once learned. We will make it easier to use and limit its capabilities so that it is not too powerful.

We will make combat without Chronostasis more dynamic; we aim to implement more audiovisual feedback, introduce the ability to dodge attacks and make enemy attack animations more predictable.
The combat in Playtest was sometimes difficult (especially with Gendarmes), but combat in Vampire Clans is intended to be challenging. Some areas of the world will be filled with formidable enemies, so you can return to them after  upgrading your equipment and vampires' abilities.

The death of one vampire during combat will not interrupt the game; other vampires will be able to resurrect him after the combat is over. When all vampires die during expeditions, they can respawn at the base or a previously activated cemetery.

We will also refine the boss fights so that each is unique and presents some different mechanics.


[h3] Stealth [/h3]
The stealth mode in Playtest was in the early stages of development. Enemies detect the player only after a moment, which is not represented graphically and is confusing. We will develop the stealth mode to make the player more aware of what is happening with a precise cone of detection consisting of different levels of detection. Enemies will react to bodies and pools of blood, and the player's role will be to hide bodies and avoid bloodshed, perform bloodless kills, and distract enemies.


[h3] Story [/h3]
We will limit the story and unnecessary dialogues but allow players to choose their answers. Each quest will be available to complete in the player's own way, avoiding limiting the player with the story and tasks.


[h3] Base Building [/h3]
Base building was limited by tasks in Playtest. In the full game, players can do whatever they want in the base, including destroying rooms and speeding up time. The player can leave the base every night, so in practice, they can do it whenever they want. Day in the base will still exist, but it can be sped up/skipped. 


[h3] Customization [/h3]
We will do our best to make character customization as advanced as possible. The main vampire, the clan leader, will not be predefined.



If you have any questions or ideas, please let us know in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.gg/pTYRKXEBjM]Discord Channel[/url].

notes.title: Vampire Clans - important information
notes.content:
Dear Vampire Clans Community,

We regret to inform you that, despite our best efforts, we were unable to prepare the demo in time for Steam Next Fest. We understand this may be disappointing news, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Our team has been ambitiously working to enhance the game by incorporating numerous new elements, including a revamped UI, new skills, and additional features. Moreover, we have been dedicating resources to localizing the game into multiple languages to ensure a wider audience can enjoy Vampire Clans.

To make it up to you, we are committed to opening playtests this holiday season. We are aiming for these to be available in July, giving you an early glimpse into the world we’ve been tirelessly crafting.

[previewyoutube=42G8A7wdLrA;full][/previewyoutube]

Additionally, we are excited to announce that we are preparing a gameplay trailer to showcase the current state of the game. This trailer will give you an insight into the progress we’ve made and what you can expect when you finally get your hands on it.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support. We can't wait to share more updates with you soon.

notes.title: Devlog #14 - Hunting
notes.content:
[i]“Each stone laid with the weight of centuries, each victory a testament to the perseverance of the immortal.”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/cea5b1ff86ce8b4eb40bc4e8c6399880c4cb75d2.jpg[/img]


Fellow Vampires,

A vampire lord is as influential as their clan is. Aren’t your brothers in arms the true sign of power? After all, they not only stand by your side but also support you with their wisdom.

Thus, we are grateful for the community of vampires on our Discord. Thank you to each and every one of you for your support, feedback, and kind words. Our team studies your activity every day and works towards creating a world where we can all conquer the lands of Paris.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/e19ad6c8bec0a9ebd152b2a27de0c78ed4acef00.png[/img]

We read your comments on the player’s perspective during Hunt. Therefore, we decided to implement changes in its distance and angle. After testing several options, we settled on the current camera’s placement, which you can see on the screen below. In addition, it’s now possible to zoom in and out so that you can adjust it to your preferences or occasionally admire the details of our characters and environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/32d80f5d4291891b9cb10f76b7ba04daeced6126.png[/img]

To stay within the subject of the environment, we’ve just incorporated some of the environmental animations and visual effects, breathing life into the undead world. Trees and grass now react to wind, and occasional flocks of birds cross the sky. But fear not if this sounds too lively to you, as a murky fog came over the lands of Paris to constantly remind you of the cold within your bones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/4c4bfc9e2efaaee370eb533a3701e99379670aee.gif[/img]

After implementing a new set of character animations, controlling your vampire is much smoother. The animation blend from the starting to the running position is on point while keeping the overall hand movement and posture natural. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/274768ca219461cd507a2218b775960af93c991d.gif[/img]

We constantly improve the main combat mechanics in the game, which is Chronostasis. We believe in its uniqueness and high fun factor; hence, polishing it is one of our priorities. The last updated version of Chronostasis includes the possibility to withdraw used actions and to see which ones have been planned to cast. Further improvements include adjustment of the character’s movement during Chronostasis, both in visual and mechanical aspects; currently, the line in which the character moves is not only visible but also knows about the obstacles on its path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/fa5344466bfab132bdc3fe0773160263f8e9702e.gif[/img]

Finally, give me some blood! 
To bring the bloodbath effect to thrilling fights, we implemented a new functionality to the visual effect of blood. Now, liquids are dynamic so that the blood dripping from your victims could leave a crimson trail of your conquest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/df065f85cdef6af7a260112ff9438f00810ebb79.png[/img]



Stay tuned and join our [url=discord.com/invite/Q7gQde9wR8]Discord[/url] channel. Feel free to share your ideas and suggestions.
discord.com/invite/Q7gQde9wR8


[url=discord.com/invite/Q7gQde9wR8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/bd47cb0be0671c138e5103292f8880b107a5e40a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #13 - Castle expansion, UI
notes.content:
[i]"In the abyss of time, I prevailed, sculpting the empire from the raw stone soaked in the slaughters I have made."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/25b6e1aab18f23305915de8fd81dd1e260841f89.jpg[/img]

Greetings, fellow Vampires!

Remember that even if you are waiting for the night, there is always the day. And the day is not a time for relaxation, let alone slacking! It is a call for diligence, growth, and perseverance. After all, is not the mighty castle itself a testament to the greatness of the Vampire Lord?

In Vampire Clans, the castle is your stronghold; improving it becomes the first stone of your Vampire's development. There is room for expansion in every corner, reflecting endless possibilities to unravel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/6ab1784e08668ab6b72ca14fbc59a7f2dfb1a0e1.png[/img]

Lately, in our graphic department, we have been primarily improving the player's experience in the base, as the quality of the interior has been enriched both in terms of the materials and the optimization. Also, we are constantly working on the gameplay mechanics within the castle. In the gif, you can see the function of building. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/f02053f1b422f7321c407226e5f8c8c7adf59956.gif[/img]

The User Interface has changed; the revamped version incorporates newly developed features and a visual style more aligned with the unique aesthetics of our game. So far, the new UI has been fully implemented in the castle, and partially in during Hunt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/dfd0413795b177c41fa8023b626eb4c98af6dccb.png[/img]

And when the night comes, we hunt. But what would hunting be without the possibility of collecting all the treasures from your victims?
Together with the implementation of the stash system, we integrated our new UI with already programmed mechanics during Hunt. The new icons include combat skills, bat skills, and potions. The UI is already interactive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/11df6497461bd103ba632ae3ae2789c3fa48d8b3.png[/img]


Stay tuned and join our [url=discord.com/invite/Q7gQde9wR8]Discord[/url] channel. Feel free to share your ideas and suggestions.

notes.title: Holidays Devlog #12
notes.content:
As winter solstice passes, nights are still longer than days, but shadows grow larger. In the biting cold, may you feel the shiver of anticipation, for the scent of blood intensifies in the crisp air. Trace the trails left in the snow, imprints of the unsuspecting prey, a morbid ballet under the watchful eyes of the night.
If it happens that you are a mortal, beware of the elongated nights, as danger lurks in them. White snow might be tempting to step on but retain yourself, as it hides the predator’s hunger. It shall absorb the warm blood fast and cover the remains so no one can find them.
But if you are a vampire, it is the time when shadows dance! May your senses be sharp, attuned to the pulse of the night, as you explore the beauty of holidays veiled in darkness.
Merry and vigilant holidays!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/1781561deefd93f0761b0f676c999f7ff786e97a.png[/img]


Our team is refining the stealth system–an integral component that elevates the combat experience within our game. The emphasis lies in enhancing various facets of this system, such as vampiric skills, character’s movement, and enemies’ field of view. We do our best to ensure a seamless and immersive stealth interaction. Moreover, our focus extends to enemies’ behavior, which we want to ensure is programmed to have natural responses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/ad22e198e88f98995a891c2992b12abe891640d5.gif[/img]


Our vampire’s unique ability–Chronostasis–is not only beneficial during combat but also vital while avoiding detection. A good mastery of the skill enables the player to roam around enemies without exiting from the stealth mode. In turn, if your vampire is spotted by enemies, Chronostasis may let you buy time to plan your further actions, whether to enter the fight or escape from the enemy’s sight.

If your vampire is sufficiently nourished with blood, they enter Chronostasis automatically the moment they are detected.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/d8edd69c902d4acd3b3bf502a73156c458adf6c0.gif[/img]


Always be aware of your surroundings; even ordinary objects can become your ally in stealth mode. You can hide under the gallows, duck into the bushes, or even take cover in the privy. The environment extends a strategic advantage, enabling vampires to hunt in unconquered areas teeming with gendarmes, vampire hunters, and rival vampire clans. Engaging in open combat within these areas may result in failure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/161d144468e913422003850640b179a42b9e7295.gif[/img]


Also, we continuously work on creating unique but historically accurate clothing designs, and implementing them into high-quality 3D models. Here, we present you with a yet-not-textured version of a modular vampire hunter’s uniform. He slays, don’t you think?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/7d55e56488a8c2ed543f82ce94d51cd5f4a4f2e7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Devlog #11
notes.content:
...

[i]In moonlight grace, while others sleep, 
Avoiding the light, we lurk on the street. 
Chills down your spine as the night unfolds, 
In the vampiric world, where darkness holds. [/i]

Greetings, brave souls of our community! We wish you a fang-tastic Halloween!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/4101f2460f973af2328435fd2367131ecfaf76dd.png[/img] 

On this mystical day, brace yourselves for the terrifying content we implemented in our game!

We are still in the process of polishing the core mechanics of the game. Most of the systems are functional and almost ready to be presented. In the gif below, you can see our signature [i]Chronostasis[/i] mode, which allows you to plan your vampires' moves in advance. Upon performing planned actions, vampires are incredibly fast and effective in combat against humans. Be always prepared, as [i]Chronostasis[/i] is only allowed when vampires are sated with human blood. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/6e707c236ce2b1fe891494109426efe4161a5a19.gif[/img]

We also implemented bosses to the game - strong enemies with unique abilities and mechanics. The first one you encounter, Mother of Spiders, is presented in the screenshot below. One of her powerful abilities is summoning a poisonous rain. Not every boss is mandatory to kill, but every one of them holds unique items. This might encourage you to face those strong opponents and explore different side quests. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/c83ac10ca4480bf7141952276f697b9e45b1f194.png[/img] 

World creation is being constantly improved; we work on enhancing the quality of materials and objects or refining the lighting. As an example of our work, we present a screenshot of a cave where the Mother of Spiders lives. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/78d2758d9435c6584529eeb130413a225e373e0d.png[/img] 

We aim to create an immersive and historically accurate environment, as we believe that [i]fangs[/i] are in the details. Therefore, we are in the midst of the creation of XIX-century costumes, architecture, and environmental tidbits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/8511f54817931a6674476b1b4eeef51231037e0a.jpg[/img] 

At the end, we present you with a part of the Chateau of Vampires. The first time you enter the castle, it seems that it fell into disrepair after some terrible event... From now on, your task is to bring back the greatness of this place and form the clan before which the entire Paris will tremble.

notes.title: Playtests Incoming for Vampire Clans! 🦇
notes.content:
Hello vampire enthusiasts!

Today marks a milestone we've been itching to share with all of you. The sun sets, and as the world plunges into the delightful embrace of twilight, we’re thrilled to announce that signups for Vampire Clans playtests are now officially open!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578940/Vampire_Clans/


🎮 Why Playtest?

For those unfamiliar with game development lingo, playtests are our way of ensuring the gameplay experience is seamless, balanced, and most importantly, fun! By inviting players to try out our game before the official release, we gather invaluable feedback to refine the gameplay, fix any lurking bugs, and ultimately ensure that the world of Vampire Clans is one you’ll want to dive into, night after night.

💪 Our Journey Thus Far...

It's been a journey of blood, sweat, and countless nights (because let's face it, vampires aren't big on daytime). From the first conceptual sketches to the intricate lore we’ve woven into the fabric of our game, every step has been taken with immense care and passion. Now, the time has come to share our hard work with a select group of players who can help us take Vampire Clans to the next level.

💌 How to Sign Up?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578940/Vampire_Clans/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/fabbc98a5eee90690dd2cac063fcbf6d9299d455.png[/img][/url]

If you're as excited as we are and wish to be among the first to experience the dark and enticing world of Vampire Clans, head over to our Steam page where you can sign up by clicking Request Access.

Remember:

Playtesting is not just about playing – we value your feedback! Please be prepared to share your thoughts, experiences, and any issues you encounter.
The game is still in development. You might encounter some issues, but that's what the playtest is for! Your understanding and patience are much appreciated.


🙏 A Big Thank You!

Lastly, we'd like to express our heartfelt gratitude to this incredible community. Your continued support, engagement, and excitement for Vampire Clans are what drives us to perfect our creation.

Get ready to embark on a supernatural journey, and may your clan reign supreme in the nights to come!

Stay nocturnal,
The Vampire Clans Dev Team 🦇❤️

notes.title: Devlog #9 - World, fighting
notes.content:
Hi Vampires! 

At this point, we have a lot of stuff to polish. We have a bunch of almost-ready maps, but we are still developing the final graphical setup for the world - to make it as good as possible, loaded with the newest technology. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/462088c8a2961dc6dc4c7baf9aab0d676b2d5525.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/d8a554aa1681a43ee7bf24e2668dfe98574894e2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/09f5a7db58130a6b4b6d4fb65ced46ced07e3e2b.jpg[/img]

We prepare destructible objects, such as fences, gravestones, and crates. Our vampires will gain a slight amount of resources from every destroyed thing to make destruction more fun. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/c23f5650fb29da8ec9a868935c203a081c52379f.gif[/img]


As you can see in the above gif, we slightly changed the fighting system. Previously, the player had to choose an enemy and pick the ability to attack - which was annoying in fast fights because of the necessity to click on the enemy accurately. Now players don't have to click on the enemies, just hold the skill key, aim with slow-mo, and release the key to cast the ability. Of course, it is much easier with slow-mo planning mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/872d908a0e918f3c622c314bf0dd52c3524db680.gif[/img]


Except for destroying objects, we are working on dismembering enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/f53dc1da026eef1d6fa205e3d89fe3df31e9cf57.png[/img]

Yeah, I know, too little blood, but it will change. We are working on particle effects to make everything more bloody. 


In the last devlog I wrote that we are working on NPCs AI. We finished but are still working on their animations, UI, and some sneaking system upgrades. After we finish, I'll show you how it works. 




I hope you like it. Tell us what you think about this update on our [url=discord.com/invite/Q7gQde9wR8]Discord[/url] channel. Feel free to share your ideas and suggestions.

notes.title: Holidays Devlog #7 - Diplomacy, clinic, graphics
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've made significant progress on Vampire Clans and are excited to share some updates with you. 

First of all, we are working on expanding the diplomacy system. Players will have access to the world map where Paris' vampire clans will be presented. From this map, there will be a possibility to send vampires to rob surrounding resource extraction sites such as sawmills, slaughterhouses, or funeral homes. If you don't want to be violent and you want to be a more diplomatic clan, you can buy resources or even take over those places with money what guarantees regular supply delivery. 


We finished the Clinic mechanic which can help your clans stay undercover and gain some resources. Vampires can have now their own business, which allows them to obtain money from cured patients or blood, bones, and human meat from killed ones. There is also a possibility to enslave patients to gain workers easily. New patients will be coming every day, but only when the clinic will have a proper reputation, otherwise much fewer of them will appear. Reputation can be gained by curing people, but even in this way there will be a possibility of losing it - not every illness is the same and some of the patients can't be cured with old surgical tools by an unexperienced doctor - if you decide to try and the patient will die, you'll lose reputation, but when it'll work you will gain much more money and reputation. You can upgrade your clinic and specialize one of your vampires in medicine to increase the chances of successful cure your patients. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/4563a225e2c0d037f94335c206f44c0ddc9b8de4.png[/img]


We are also making new 3D models for the game, you can see more by following our discord channel. We hope you like it.

notes.title: Devlog #6 - Upgrades and crafting
notes.content:
Hello Vampires! In this devlog, I want to show you how you can upgrade Vampires' base, craft items, and resources. 

First, we improved the inventory and chests system to allow players to manage their resources in the base better. Also, now there is a warehouse on the base, where vampires can store and share all their resources. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/ebd72571aef012cd51282ee1bf179d85acaad498.gif[/img]


We also added a crafting system that allows players to craft new items in various crafting stations. Now, to upgrade or build a room you need special resources which you can get in Paris streets or you can craft them in your base. To do so, you need to place a crafting station in one of your special crafting rooms (smithy, workshop, etc.), grab the required resources, and then send one of your servants to craft whatever you need. It takes time, but once you order the servant to work, he will be doing this as long as he runs out of resources. During this time you can do whatever you want, e.g. send your vampires to hunt some fresh blood. Everyone in your base can work on their own.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/96eb1f97413db86fcceb9d6b7cbb950ca074fb84.gif[/img]


I mentioned crafting stations before - those are upgrades that you can build within the rooms. Every room has its own set of available upgrades and there could be more of them than space in the room (so you may need more rooms of the same type, or expand the existing one). Every crafting station unlocks new items to craft, they are necessary to expand your clan!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/9c616591a78d5ade111072a512176b77ae474679.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #5 - Quests, equipment, stats, and more
notes.content:
Hello Vampires! 

I want to show you what we have been working on since the last devlog. 

First of all, we upgraded Vampire Clans to Unreal Engine 5, there is some work to finish, but it looks much better even now. We added Lumen Global Illumination, a lighting system that works like a ray tracing, but it works by software. It means, that you don't have to have an expensive graphic card to use it. Also, a Temporal Super-Resolution helps to play in high detail on not the newest PCs/laptops. TSR can upsample 1080p to 4k without noticeable changes in quality. So, now on the laptop with graphic card 1050 Ti and Intel i5 - 7300U, we reached a stable 30 FPS on high settings (120 on low) in Full HD with software ray tracing turned on (Lumen) - without TSR in this setup game runs at unstable 12 FPS. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/a0b277f6ec529f34b602764629b424abe419e1a2.png[/img]


Another thing we made is a quest system and questlines. Besides the main story, there will be a lot of side quests that will help e.g. with collecting unique alchemy ingredients to make powerful potions or with finding artifacts. There will be random quests in-game too, which will let you help people (or hinder) with achieving their goals. Why a vampire should help someone? Apart from additional rewards, those citizens will be loyal to your clan. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/2eafb5534c542ad8c8cea913dc70bdb52c6c41f3.gif[/img]


Equipment and stats - we made a statistics system. A lot of stats that can be upgraded on every level of vampire. Stats are highly connected with equipment, every item has bonuses to stats, and the amount of bonuses and their power depends on the rarity, type, and upgrade level of an item. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/22fd2e32272efdd118bed13f2e7e0dfa6ed3344b.gif[/img]


Also, we added a lot of new things that vampires can do in the world e.g. looting chests, and corpses, making potions, or even cutting a tree... but wait, that's not befitting a majestic vampire, so we made slaves system. Vampires now can kidnap people and close them to a prison, then they have to listen to orders from vampires (I mean, they won't always be, but vampires can just drink their blood and throw corpses into dogs' caves). To have good slaves, vampires, unfortunately, have to take care of them by giving them food or not letting their overwork. Mental health is also important, working with corpses for a long time is not good for people. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/c8682d6ffed2cc73f912ac5a282702ec1a8cf7d4.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Fighting and animations
notes.content:
Hello Vampires lords! 

After a long work, I can finally show you the fighting system which we just finished. 

Fighting in Vampire Clans is based on a slow-motion tactic, which is almost like an active pause but your vamps could be hit if you are making your decision too long. Of course, you can use a traditional real-time playstyle based on your reflex.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/cdd438b4c1080c486a339573a352a6b945e79aca.gif[/img]

There are two modes of vampire locomotion. In one of them, the vampire is acting normal, just like normal people do. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/176fbc30c3da73a87dec7660481f8bc875828d5b.gif[/img]

The second mode is fighting mode, which allows the vampire to move and fight super-fast, adds damage, and - what is most important - adds the vampire sense. Vampire sense turns on slow motion when the vampire is attacked (and when he's not moving), which allows him to make effective dodges and counterattacks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/ab1ecf7839e7d4c4aba50991f59f53e3642bc575.gif[/img]

We also upgraded an AI of NPCs. Now they are not only running from vampires, but they can start to attack him. In gifs, you can see the people using crossbows. They are trying to avoid a direct and close meeting with the vampire. When the vampire is too close to them, they are moving back, and the further NPCs are slowly moving toward the vampire and trying to shoot him. During this, NPCs are always trying to surround the vampire and don't let him escape. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/3e8870f258a2095595e5892e2eebb744de7a990a.gif[/img]

In addition to this, we made new moving animations that are much smoother than the previous ones. Also, there are two camera modes, one of them is an unlocked camera. The second one is a lock on target mode. You can now lock on camera on your current vampire to make an RPG playstyle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/1741b20cd0fa2d9ef8c449e40943bdda54f47b1c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Building and management
notes.content:
Hello Vamps!
Today we want to show you what we just did in Vampire Clans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/efb6fdd3a63d83e101e1e4c6ce705013ab1765e2.gif[/img]

Since now, our vampires can build, upgrade and manage their underground base! You will be able to choose from a lot of room types, each of them will have special functionality for a clan, like a prison, slaughterhouse, dogs lair, or alchemist laboratory. Every room will have a few visual variations and some options to customize to make your vampires feel like in the home, and your prisoners like in hell. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/5c69ddd2e42ccda7cb214c5371f3ce00c4677798.gif[/img]

As a clan, vampires can now share blood supplies, imprison people and collect resources for growth the strongest clan in Paris. 

Additionally, we are implementing a new user interface, which part you can see on the gifs. tell us what do you think about it. 

Don't forget to join our discord channel to share your ideas, suggestions, or just to talk.

notes.title: Devlog #2 - NPC
notes.content:
Hello Vampires! I'd love to introduce you to what we just implemented. Now, Paris streets are teeming with life. We made a system, that allows NPCs to live their own lives - until Vampires kill them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/637670d0d17493130ba85019d3b375239186af90.gif[/img]


Those innocent people deal with the difficulties of everyday life, taking care of their health, but they don't know that vampires who love healthy fresh blood lurk in the dark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/a30974c6cde17b73d9f60b4bebbd8a2f1a9b1215.gif[/img]


Of course, NPCs are "drinkable" now, but they won't allow vampires to do this without effort, they are running, hiding, and trying to avoid every dark lord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275994/a15573161ed216d7f8001edaf172be6213ebf12d.gif[/img]



If you have any suggestions, ideas or just want to chat - feel free to join our discord channel [url=https://discord.gg/Q7gQde9wR8]https://discord.gg/Q7gQde9wR8[/url]
